holder-quote: Valeterisa looked unconvinced herself. She took a carrot and sipped at a cup of tea. Her face fell.
effect-quote: That’s a lot of raw vegetables…and I hate potatoes!

holder-quote: Valeterisa turned. She peered at Bezale.
effect-quote: “Hm. Minotaur. Female. You must be Bezale, contact of…[Recall Memories]. Scriptels. Note on record about loyalty. Mage Montressa. Hello.”
